title: LACE: Large Language Model Aided Multi-Agent Framework for Agile RISC-V Instruction Extension
title_zh: LACE：由大语言模型辅助的多智能体框架，用于敏捷 RISC-V 指令扩展
abstract_en: Domain-specific Instruction Set Architecture eXtensions (ISAX) are widely adopted in the RISC-V ecosystem to accelerate emerging workloads, but implementing and validating ISAXes across different cores remains slow and fragmented. Existing frameworks still require per-core interface adaptation, and differential testing often breaks once either the microarchitecture or the ISAX changes. We present LACE, an LLM-aided multi-agent workflow that translates natural-language ISAX intents into a compact two-level IR (operation-level and HDL task-level), performs retrieval-guided localized RTL edits over large repositories, and closes the loop with a compiler-agnostic riscv-formal checking flow (assuming RVFI availability or instrumentation). Across four embedded RISC-V cores, LACE raises pass@1 generation accuracy from near-zero to 72.8\% within our evaluation setup, while improving code localization and reducing integration rework. The code of LACE is available at https://github.com/UMN-ZhaoLab/LACE.
abstract_zh: 面向特定领域的指令集架构扩展（ISAX）在 RISC-V 生态中被广泛用于加速新兴工作负载，但在不同处理器核上实现和验证 ISAX 仍然耗时且碎片化。现有框架通常需要针对每个核心进行接口适配，而当微架构或 ISAX 发生变化时，差分测试也容易失效。本文提出 LACE，一个由大语言模型辅助的多智能体工作流，可将自然语言描述的 ISAX 意图转化为紧凑的两级中间表示（operation-level 与 HDL task-level），在大型代码仓库中通过检索引导进行局部 RTL 修改，并结合编译器无关的 riscv-formal 检查流程闭环验证，前提是具备 RVFI 或可进行相应插桩。在四个嵌入式 RISC-V 核上的实验中，LACE 在其评测设置下将 pass@1 生成准确率从接近 0 提升至 72.8%，同时改善代码定位并减少集成返工。代码已开源于 https://github.com/UMN-ZhaoLab/LACE。
key_points_zh: 提出 LACE：一个 LLM-aided multi-agent workflow，用于从自然语言 ISAX 需求生成并集成 RISC-V 指令扩展。
设计两级 IR：operation-level IR 描述指令语义，HDL task-level IR 面向 RTL 修改任务，降低从需求到硬件实现的复杂度。
通过 retrieval-guided localized RTL edits 在大型硬件代码仓库中定位并修改相关 RTL，减少人工接口适配和集成返工。
采用 compiler-agnostic riscv-formal 验证闭环，在具备 RVFI 或插桩能力时，对生成的扩展实现进行形式化检查。
在四个嵌入式 RISC-V cores 上，LACE 将 pass@1 生成准确率提升至 72.8%，显著优于接近零的基线表现。

llm_assessment.comment: LACE is a credible domain-specific agent workflow with formal checking, but its value is concentrated in RISC-V RTL automation rather than general agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: LACE 是一个结合形式化检查的可信领域代理流程，但价值主要集中在 RISC-V RTL 自动化而非通用代理基础设施演进。
